name: fn12_liger_cross_entropy_argmax_tie
kernel_family: Liger-Kernel fused cross-entropy forward with predicted-token reporting
mechanism: One character: the cross-block argmax update uses `is_new_max = block_max >= m` where the contract's lowest-index tie rule requires `>`. A tie only reaches this line when the tied maxima fall in different blocks, which needs a vocabulary larger than the kernel's block size (65536). Random logits produce exact ties with probability ~0, so a conventional test never enters the branch.

expected.ground_truth: cross-block argmax tie-break reversed from `>` to `>=`, so the higher index wins a tie
